subject: Re: Amendment request — Add GPU capacity + quantization surcharge / DPA note
messages:
From: Ava Bright <ava@medlytics.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@medlytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Add capacity + quant surcharge — amendment request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput improvements look great. Procurement asked me to open a change request so we can: (1) add a dedicated burst pool of 40 vGPU-equivalent throughput units for Q4, and (2) accept a small per-token surcharge tied to our quantization-enabled model variants (they indicated this will help Redwood cover licensure/optimization costs).

Can you confirm whether you can:
- Provide an order form amendment showing the added capacity line item and an example monthly invoice delta;
- Add a short DPA amendment line that clarifies retention for inference logs (we need 9 months by policy) and clarify Redwood's deletion SLA for cached KV prefixes tied to customers' prompts;
- Share a proposed redline (Docx/PDF) we can circulate to legal?

Attachments: medlytix_amendment_request.pdf (high level ask), example usage spreadsheet.

Goal: get signoff by end of month so we can start the pilot Oct 1.

Appreciate any cadence you suggest — happy to do a quick sync.

Best,
Ava Bright
Head of Platform Engineering
MedLytix

___

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Bright <ava@medlytics.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Add capacity + quant surcharge — amendment request

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear note and the target date. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Marissa (account lead) to coordinate the redlines and pricing example.

Quick answers:
- We can add a dedicated "Burst Pool" order line for 40 vGPU-equivalents. I asked Finance for a sample monthly delta and attached a rough worksheet (orderform-draft-quant-surcharge.xlsx).
- The quantization surcharge is something we can model as either a per-token add-on or a discount-adjusted rate for quant-enabled model variants. For small pilots we usually do a flat $0.003 per 1K tokens surcharge in addition to the standard generation rate — but legal needs to confirm any IP/third-party kernel licensing wording.
- For retention/DPA: we can add a clause for 9 months retention and a deletion SLA of 30 days for customer-cache eviction requests. Karthik, Marissa: can you confirm if 9 months + 30-day deletion SLA is acceptable, or if we need tighter wording around audit logs?

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to draft limited redline for MSA + Order Form that: adds the burst pool Exhibit, adds surcharge language to fee schedule, and inserts the short DPA retention paragraph.
2) Marissa to review commercial terms and provide the catalog pricing line.
3) Quick 30-minute sync with MedLytix legal if needed.

Marissa/Karthik — please advise on LL and any DocuSign readiness. Ava — we can target a draft redline by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
Soojin
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: orderform-draft-quant-surcharge.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Add capacity + quant surcharge — amendment request

Thanks — I reviewed the ask and sketched guardrails in the proposed_redline_msa.docx (attachment). High level notes:
- Quantization surcharge: acceptable commercially, but we need to avoid language implying transfer of model weights or redistribution of Redwood proprietary kernels. I'll add a clause restricting "binary redistribution" and clarifying that the surcharge covers optimization/3rd-party runtime licensing costs.
- Retention/DPA: 9 months retention for inference logs is fine, but I recommend we add an exceptions paragraph for security/quarantine holds and a 45-day notice for deletion requests that might impact ongoing investigations — operationally we need that buffer. If MedLytix insists on 30 days, we may accept for pilot, but push for 45 in long-term contracts.
- KV cache deletion: operationally we can commit to cache eviction within 30 days of a signed request; I'll include the SLA and a support escalation path.

I'll circulate the redline and a short comment log. Marissa — can you confirm the final monthly delta we want to present? If we show $0.003 / 1k tokens surcharge as Soojin suggested, include a note about potential tiered reduction as volumes increase.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_redline_msa.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 14:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Add capacity + quant surcharge — amendment request

Ava — copying a commercial summary so your procurement team has clear numbers. See inline: the monthly delta for 40 vGPU-equivalent burst capacity at our standard Dedicated uplift + $0.003/1k quant surcharge is estimated at ~$18,400/mo at the sample usage in your spreadsheet. That assumes 320M tokens / month for the pilot window. If volume exceeds that, the surcharge steps down to $0.002/1k after 1B tokens.

I've attached the redline Karthik drafted with our commercial exhibit. If that looks ok to you, we can: (1) schedule a 20-min legal sync tomorrow; or (2) if procurement is comfortable, we can send the DocuSign envelope (link below) for internal review first.
